description: Na₄Mg(FeO₂)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.43 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight FeO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.39 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.63 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.25 Å. There are four inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.17 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.97 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.14 Å. In the fourth Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-1.97 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra and corners with four ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid.
